categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily as a holding company controlling subsidiaries engaged in plastic product manufacturing (synthetic resin and polyurethane foam), automotive parts manufacturing, and real estate rental. Key subsidiaries include JinYang Chemical, JinYang Industrial, JinYang Polyurethane, and JinYang Automotive, focusing on synthetic resin products, polyurethane foam, automotive interior parts, and real estate management respectively.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced polymer processing technologies including calendering for PVC synthetic leather and flooring, polyurethane foam manufacturing with specialized formulations such as slow recovery memory foam, and automotive interior component molding. Production methods emphasize high-quality, high-value-added specialty products with stable supply chains for raw materials like PPG and TDI sourced mainly from affiliated companies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include domestic and international automotive manufacturers and suppliers, construction and building material distributors, and real estate tenants. The synthetic resin products serve flooring, furniture, and automotive interior markets, while automotive parts are supplied to major car manufacturers including GM. The company also exports raw materials and intermediate goods to affiliated overseas subsidiaries.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are concentrated in South Korea with production facilities in Ulsan, Yangsan, Pyeongtaek, Incheon, Gimhae, and Busan. Export markets include China, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, South America, the US, and Europe. The company maintains a global supply chain and sales network, particularly for automotive and synthetic resin products.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment as a manufacturer of intermediate and finished plastic products and automotive components. It sources raw materials such as resins and chemical intermediates from upstream suppliers, including affiliated chemical companies, and supplies finished goods to downstream customers like automotive OEMs and distributors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include focusing on core businesses through selective investment and M&A, expanding overseas markets, and enhancing management efficiency. R&D efforts target environmentally friendly, high-value-added products such as bio-based PVC and slow recovery memory foam, with continuous innovation in automotive interior materials and synthetic resin applications to sustain growth and competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through product sales of synthetic resin products, polyurethane foam, and automotive parts, as well as dividend income, brand licensing fees, management consulting fees from subsidiaries, and real estate rental income. The company also exports raw materials to affiliated overseas subsidiaries, contributing to export revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In synthetic resin and PVC flooring, competitors include LX Hausys, Kolon Glotech, and KCC Glass, with the company holding a competitive position through advanced technology and product differentiation. In automotive parts, competition is intense with global suppliers, but the company maintains competitiveness via quality, diversification, and strategic partnerships. The polyurethane foam market is competitive with six domestic firms, where the company is a leading player.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, the company reported consolidated assets of approximately 643 billion KRW and revenues of about 271 billion KRW, reflecting a 15.6% increase in sales and a 37% increase in net income year-over-year. The company maintains a stable capital structure with a debt-to-equity ratio around 50.7% and continues to invest in facility expansion and new product development to support growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, environmentally friendly, and high-value-added products such as bio-based PVC synthetic leather and slow recovery memory foam. It leverages strong R&D capabilities, stable raw material supply from affiliated companies, and diversified product applications across automotive, construction, and consumer goods sectors to differentiate itself and meet evolving customer needs.
